svg.title: WHERE filters rows, HAVING filters groups
svg.desc: Eight flights. WHERE dep_delay > 0 removes f3 and f7 before any grouping, leaving six rows. GROUP BY carrier forms three groups: AA with f4, DL with f2 and f6, UA with f1, f5, and f8. Each group collapses to one row with its COUNT(*): AA 1, DL 2, UA 3. HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 then removes the AA group, leaving DL and UA.
svg.text: WHERE filters rows before grouping. HAVING filters groups after.
HAVING can test an aggregate such as COUNT(*), because by the time it runs each group is one row.
drops f3 and f7 (6 rows remain)
